messages.app.title: AC8 Player Tools
messages.app.heading: Installation and Maintenance
messages.app.subtitle: Choose an installation mode, connect Steam and manage loader files.
messages.language.label: Language
messages.path.hint: Choose the game root or Win64 folder, or paste the EXE path.
messages.path.gameDialog: Select the AC8 game folder (root or Win64)
messages.path.steamDialog: Select steam.exe in the Steam installation folder
messages.mode.heading: Installation mode · all include flight control
messages.mode.guidanceDetail: Changes guidance only; preserves stock performance, fuze settings and appearance.
messages.mode.fullDetail: Enables guidance, performance, proximity-fuze and appearance changes.
messages.mode.noneDetail: Installs flight control only; missiles remain unchanged.
messages.steam.instructions: After saving, copy the launch options into Steam → AC8 → Properties → General.
messages.runtime.heading: In-game controls · included in every mode
messages.runtime.hmd: F2 toggles HMD. It starts disabled; four inward ticks indicate that it is enabled.
messages.runtime.camera: F3 native / farther camera · hold C for free look
messages.runtime.lock: HMD helps select targets; weapons still require their normal lock.
messages.maintenance.hint: For old loader files, confirm ownership and back up before cleanup.
messages.footer.console: Keep the launcher console open while playing and wait for cleanup after exit.
messages.status.idle: Check and cleanup results appear here. Python and NumPy are not needed for normal play.
messages.status.wait: Please wait. The result will appear here when the operation finishes.
messages.status.savedMode: Saved: {mode}. Takes effect on the next launch.
messages.dialog.cleanupBody: The tool will check the loader files, verify a backup, then clean them up. Confirm that these files belong to AC8 Integrated. Cancel if their origin is unknown or they belong to another mod. Game path: {path}
messages.dialog.waitBody: A check or cleanup is still running. You can close the window when it finishes.
messages.error.gamePath: AC8 was not found at the selected location.
messages.error.gameBuild: The game build does not match this package.
messages.error.packageInsideGame: The package is inside the game directory.
messages.error.movePackage: Move the entire package outside the game directory, then run the installer again.
messages.error.gameRunning: The game is running. Exit normally and try again.
messages.error.unsaved: The current selection has not been saved. Save settings first.
messages.error.ownership: File ownership could not be established. The files have been retained.
messages.error.permission: Cannot write to {path}. Check file permissions and security-software protection history.
messages.error.generic: Operation incomplete: {reason}. See the diagnostic log.
messages.analysis.noPython: Optional analysis skipped: no usable Python installation was found. Python is not required for normal play.
messages.analysis.noNumpy: Optional analysis skipped: NumPy is unavailable in the selected Python environment.
messages.safety.offline: Do not use online or in multiplayer. Offline single-player only.
